title: kith-tslocal: add hyper + hyper-util to Cargo.toml
description:
Add hyper, hyper-util, and http-body-util as direct dependencies to crates/kith-tslocal/Cargo.toml. These are in Cargo.lock (pulled by axum) but must be declared explicitly for kith-tslocal to import them.

What: Add three dep entries to kith-tslocal/Cargo.toml.

Algorithm:
1. Read current crates/kith-tslocal/Cargo.toml
2. Add to [dependencies]: hyper = { workspace = true, features = ["client", "http1"] }
3. Add: hyper-util = { workspace = true, features = ["tokio"] }
4. Add: http-body-util = { workspace = true }
5. Ensure workspace Cargo.toml has hyper, hyper-util, http-body-util as workspace deps (they may already be there via axum - verify in Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock)
6. Run: cargo build -p kith-tslocal to verify it compiles

Defensive rules:
- Do not add unnecessary features (only client + http1 for hyper; no server features)
- Verify versions match what is already in Cargo.lock (hyper 1.9.0, hyper-util 0.1.20)
- If workspace does not already declare these, add them with exact versions matching Cargo.lock

Acceptance: cargo build -p kith-tslocal succeeds with hyper imported in lib.rs
